scope: Focused independently authored production admission reservation change; not public-source promotion
problem: Greedy byte-budget eviction could destroy all eligible farther resident meshes and then reject the incoming growth because the reclaimable bytes were insufficient.
implementation: Compute required peak reservation including both old target and incoming allocation before releasing anything.
Collect strictly farther nonbusy GPU-bearing candidates; insufficient aggregate eligible bytes returns false without page, buffer, history or queue mutation.
Stable farthest-first ordering preserves insertion-order tie behavior. Release only the sufficient prefix on nominal success.
Exclude zero-GPU placeholders from byte reclamation; discovery's separate page-count eviction remains unchanged.
Candidate list and sort are bounded by existing2048-page map; no resident GPU cap increase and no added persistent mirror/buffer. Temporary list/sort allocations are not a measured heap/frame bound.
native_fixture_limits: Actual production upload/eviction, real mesher-generated target/far/busy geometry, actual native32MiB allocations and exact native buffer-size accounting.
Private pages bypass discovery and are not drawn as an actual scene. Near allocation is patterned ballast. Real rendered-frame scheduling is tested separately.
Readback proxy adds COPY_SRC only to test allocations and is restored in finally; no shipping usage flag change.
Sixteen32MiB fixture setups run within bounded validation action; deferred backend frees can temporarily accumulate. The tracked per-renderer32MiB limit is not process/GPU peak memory acceptance.
preserved_by_source_scope: modular Vulkan primary and OpenGL fallback
remaining_limits: Sufficient plan followed by allocation/encoding failure can still lose selected victims; no allocation/device-loss atomicity guarantee.
No automatic retry policy or whole-cohort GPU transaction guarantee.
Reservation collection/sort and successful upload are synchronous; no hard2ms/full-frame/FPS guarantee.
No actual visible discovery/travel/cap-churn, full-stream/ocean, full enabled-view/LOD coverage, owner-GPU or comparative-market acceptance.
Stale fixture outputs and empty built graphics descriptor retained; underlying writer/cache/artifact causes remain unproven.
